name: variety
description: Iconic scenes from film, TV, games and anime as short seeds — the model knows these worlds, so the prompts stay terse and the upsampler stages them. No house style: each scene matches the look of the thing it references.
style: No fixed house style. Each scene picks the look that genuinely suits its idea and commits to it completely — photoreal cinema, stop-motion, hand-drawn animation, 35mm film, documentary handheld, anime, claymation, IMAX nature footage, grainy VHS, whatever the idea calls for. When a scene references a known film, show, game or franchise, match that world's actual look, palette, costume, lighting and sound design as faithfully as you can — the grade, the lens, the era. Choose deliberately and describe the look concretely: lens, lighting, palette, texture, grain, motion.
